summary: This joint resolution expresses support for designating June as "Life Month" to recognize the inherent dignity and worth of every human life, reaffirm the right to life, commend those who promote a culture of life, and urge policymakers to protect the unborn and support women and families.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is entirely focused on promoting a 'culture of life,' explicitly referencing the Dobbs decision and urging policymakers to protect the unborn. Its primary purpose is to advocate for policies that restrict abortion access.
